messages:
Sam T: Quick heads-up — Prospect 'GreenMesa' asking for SOC 2 report excerpt, ISO cert snippet, and a signed pen-test authorisation. They want their vendor to run scans against our staging and possibly a single-tenant dedicated pool. Also asking for ephemeral creds (S3 presign + short-lived SSH) and an ops cost estimate for an 8h 2x-A100 window. Who signs the attestation?

Priya K: We typically send redacted SOC2 + ISO27001 cert excerpt + control-mapping. Legal signs the pen-test attestation; security provides the approved scope/contact. We do NOT share raw host logs or permanent host creds.

Liam O: Ephemeral access is fine. We can do presigned S3 for evidence + timeboxed SSH via the jumpbox (one-time JWT). If they want direct host access or root creds we decline. If they require dedicated machines warmed for the scan that's a reserved burst and has cost. Also request the vendor's ATO and insurance proof.

Nina G: Legal can sign our standard pen-test attestation. If the buyer requests changes to indemnity/limitation of liability we escalate. Important: confirm whether the test will target dedicated customer infra vs shared infra — affects wording.

Infra Bot: Pre-signed upload ready: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/greenmesa-1767012345 (expires in 48h). Please upload vendor scope & redlines to /greenmesa/vendor-scope/.

Sam T: Pricing ask — any quick ballpark for an 8h reservation of 2x A100 + ops support?

Liam O: Ballpark: 8h on 2x A100 ≈ 0.35x of a daily Dedicated rate. Rough math => ~$900 for infra + ~$300 for ops/scheduling = ~$1.2k. If they stretch to 24h it ~2x that. These are estimates; Mira in capacity team can confirm.

Priya K: I'll relay ~ $1.2k estimate and note legal can sign once we have scope + IP list. Action items: 1) Sam upload vendor scope to presign link. 2) Liam to share scope template. 3) Nina to prepare signature-ready attestation. 4) Infra Bot to provision creds after approvals.

Nina G: Suggested attestation language: "Redwood Inference will limit testing to the agreed scope and timeframe; Redwood Inference does not accept responsibility for vulnerabilities identified outside the agreed scope." I'll review final redlines if they send any.

Sam T: Uploaded: vendor scope + vendor ATO docs + preliminary IP list. Tagging buyer to provide final IP allowlist and any redlines. :white_check_mark:

Liam O: FYI if vendor asks for VPN instead of IP allowlist that adds ~1 business day of ops and a separate cost.

Priya K: Great — I'll update the customer and ask for redlines/IP list and timeline. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
